name: supermind
description: Product development with automatic, evidence-backed capability reuse.

interface.longDescription: Turn product intent into working software while automatically discovering and evaluating verified capabilities. A standalone local Python CLI records immutable memory events and synchronizes incremental commits with your private GitHub repository. Browse the categorized, collapsible README, capability cards, and relationship graphs. Models and vectors stay local; no resident service is required.
defaultPrompt: Use Supermind to build this product intent.
Use Supermind to add this feature.
Use Supermind to improve this product.
Use Supermind to show the capability library.
